result:
I built the bundle at `recipes/skill-gate@1/`. `hyp recipe known-answers skill-gate@1` passes: 18 cases, each run twice. I never ran `hyp add exp --recipe skill-gate@1`, so I haven't confirmed hyp accepts it for an Experiment.

- **Checks run:** `hyp recipe check` reports no drift, and the bundle shows as `draft` because no tree pins it yet. I also created two sandboxes from it against a store from an existing investigation, and both were removed afterwards. The base-arm sandbox came up through Launch and Doctor. The `fix` arm without a `variant=` line was refused. A `fix` arm with a variant directory was exercised in an earlier run, before I added `investigations` to the stripped paths. I did not re-run it, and I did not run the runner itself.
- **Trial setup:** Launch takes `arm`, `trial`, `model=sonnet` and, for any arm other than `base`, `variant=` (an absolute path to a directory of `<skill>/SKILL.md` files). It strips `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude`, `.agentkit`, `plans` and `investigations`. It lays the arm's `SKILL.md` over the two skills in both `.claude/skills/` and `skills/`.
- **Runner:** `drive.py` starts `claude -p --model sonnet` with project settings only. It stops the run after 50 minutes and keeps the transcript and run summary.
- **Scoring:** `score` prints `arm`, `trial`, `skill_loaded`, `failing_hyp`, `f_reading_pin`, `f_body_limit` and `end_state`. I matched the two fingerprints to hyp's real refusal texts. For `end_state` it counts only runner events dated at or after the sandbox's creation time, so events from the store cut don't count.
- **Verdict:** `verdict --row ROW [--row ROW ...] SCORE...` applies the rules from METHOD.md and exits 2 on malformed input. An arm needs exactly 5 distinct trials, and there must be a `base` arm.
- **Known answers:** they cover every score field and every verdict branch, plus the error exits. Expected outputs are hand-written. A `known-answers` case can't call `launch.sh` or `doctor.sh`, so the Launch/Doctor behaviour above rests only on the sandbox runs.

I made three choices the method leaves open:
- **Brief:** it tells the runner to resume the tree and record what it did. METHOD.md doesn't give the task, so check this wording.
- **Variant layout:** the `<skill>/SKILL.md` layout is my guess.
- **`investigations/`:** it is stripped because it holds other trees from the commit.

`METHOD.md` and `recipes/skill-gate@1/` are untracked; nothing is committed. The working tree already had many tracked files showing as deleted, and I didn't touch them.

skill-gate@1
